title: Domain Starting-Template Corpus (Lathe + Mill + WEDM) + Taptite-Electrode Excel-Macro Bridge
rationale: Every print, program, CAD/CAM file in JM Die's 24,545-file corpus becomes structured training data. Per-domain matcher engines propose 'this new job looks like these 5 we've already shipped — start from that template.' The taptite-electrode Excel macro at 'JM DIE/Automated Program_Corrected 5-25.xlsm' is bridged as a READ-ONLY first-class asset (parsed-snapshot path for MS0; live-Excel COM deferred to v2). Every electrode part is audited for coverage. No auto-emit — templates feed the gated pipeline in MACRO-PROGRAM-PIPELINE-MS0, operator-in-the-loop is unconditional. Historical S/F values treated as DATA not GROUND TRUTH per feedback_box_programs_amateur — physics-derived recommendations win on disagreement.

exit_gate: All 7 units shipped with per-engine: real tests (reference values or algebraic invariants — NO toBeDefined() stubs; happy + ≥3 failure modes + ≥2 adversarial), dispatcher wiring (import + call + action enum + Zod schema), round-trip E2E assertion through every wired dispatcher. ≥3 families per domain (wafer-insert/casing/shaft/flange for lathe; taptite/electrode/plate for mill; taptite-electrode/carbide-die/punch-die for WEDM). Read-only against Automated Program_Corrected 5-25.xlsm — audits MUST NOT write to .xlsm (asserted in U3/U4 tests with explicit fs.statSync(...).mtimeMs equality). Every template-emit path gated by S(x) ≥ 0.70 + sim + operator-in-the-loop (delegated to MACRO-PROGRAM-PIPELINE-MS0 safety gate). /learn-corpus skill registered + scenario-tested. ENGINE_DIGEST + DISPATCHER_DIGEST regenerated. MILESTONE_PROGRESS + BUILD_STATE regenerated. 3-of-3 scrutiny PASS at close-out. omega_floor 1.0 met.
